tipeeestream.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to TipeeeStream right now.

tipeeestream.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a TipeeeStream event inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to TipeeeStream and it works without a connection.
tipeeestream.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test event was sent, false when the kind is unknown.
